_README: Profile read by the judgment stage. Anything marked 'confirmed': false is an educated guess, NOT verified with the customer — the judgment stage must not present an alert as HS-code-specific while these are unconfirmed.

language.alert_format: Bahasa Indonesia, plus a one-line English gloss

contact._todo: Readme next step 2 — get the real compliance contact.

hs_codes._todo: MA is an importer of raw materials and domestic manufacturer. Export declaration (PEB) is parked for when export lanes activate.

candidates.basis: PVC resin (Polyvinyl chloride in primary forms) — imported raw material (requires PI/import permit evaluation)
DOP (Dioctyl phthalate plasticizer) — imported chemical additive
Plastic stabilizers & anti-oxidants — imported raw materials
Textile fabrics impregnated/coated with PVC — woven substrate / intermediate
Tarpaulins, awnings, and sunblinds — manufactured finished good
PVC sheets, non-cellular — manufactured finished good

destination_markets._todo: Currently domestic sales; export markets parked until international lanes activate.

likely_relevant: Import restrictions, quotas, and licensing (PI TPT, PI B2, Laporan Surveyor / LS Import, Surat Pengecualian B3 / KLHK)
Customs tariffs, Bea Masuk (BM), PPh Pasal 22 Import, PPN Import on plastics/chemicals (Ch. 29, Ch. 38, Ch. 39, Ch. 59)
KBLI licensing, OSS risk verification, and mandatory SNI product standards
Environmental and B3 / non-B3 waste and chemical handling regulations (KLHK / DLH Surabaya)
Labor, OHS (K3), and local Surabaya/East Java municipal Perda
Parked: PEB / export procedures become relevant once export lanes are enabled
almost_never_relevant: Harga Patokan Ekspor (HPE) / Harga Referensi decrees for mining, palm oil, agriculture and forestry
Daftar Merek RBD Palm Olein (branded cooking oil export registers)
Single-commodity rules for unrelated sectors: coal, nickel ore, kratom, fertilizer, fresh fruit
relevance_guidance._note: This is guidance for judgment, not a keyword filter. A rule in the 'almost never' list can still matter if it changes an underlying customs procedure that applies to all importers/manufacturers — read it, don't pattern-match it.
